## Library prep

Lindsay Droit (Washington University School of Medicine) walks through how a
swab becomes a sequencing library for 16S and for RNA-seq. Her slides will be
added here.

## Practical details

**Venue.** Golden Tulip Westlands, Nairobi. Monday 9 to Friday 13 November 2026.

**Evenings.** Dinner together on Monday for instructors, teaching assistants and
participants, and a networking evening midweek. Both are optional, but we hope
you come.

**Your group.** There are ten groups of six. You meet your group on Wednesday
morning. On Friday your group presents to one paired group that worked on the
other dataset, and listens to theirs.

**Getting set up.** Follow [Getting Started](../../../getting-started.qmd) before
Tuesday morning. You need a GitHub account and the Codespace from the workshop
template repository. If anything fails, find a teaching assistant on Monday
rather than on Tuesday.
